stem.text: Which statements about the Michaelis–Menten constant ($K_\text{m}$) of an enzyme are correct?

items: At the $K_\text{m}$ value, half the active sites of the enzyme should be occupied by the substrate.
$K_\text{m}$ represents the substrate concentration at which the enzyme is working at half its maximum rate.
The lower the $K_\text{m}$ value, the lower the affinity of the enzyme to its substrate.
When an enzyme has a high $K_\text{m}$ value, the enzyme-catalysed reaction will proceed very slowly to its maximum rate.
